units.source_text: 按着你指示的地方，我整整挖了两天。

en.t: Following the place you pointed out, I dug for two whole days.

units.source_text: 然而，别说骨头，就连小屋的残片，竟一块也没有挖出。

en.t: And yet, never mind bones, I did not dig up so much as a single scrap of the hut.

units.source_text: 于是，你又指了一个地方。

en.t: Then you pointed to another place.

units.source_text: 那里也是什么也没有，你的指示又改变了。

en.t: There was nothing there either, and your directions changed again.

units.source_text: 就这样，折腾了五次，算起日子来，怕有九天了吧，一直是徒劳。

en.t: In that way I was put through it five times, and counting the days it must have been about nine days, all of it wasted effort.

units.source_text: 结果，你又露出哭丧的脸，开始辩解。

en.t: In the end, you put on that mournful face again and began making excuses.

units.source_text: 说什么房子的位置像是改变过了，说什么不间断的沙的压力，也许使得正房自身的位置、角度都有些错位了，洞穴自身，也许从原来的位置移动开了。

en.t: You said things like the position of the house seemed to have changed, and that the constant pressure of the sand might have shifted the main house itself, its position and angle, and that the pit itself might have moved away from its original place.

units.source_text: 说不定家畜小屋、丈夫和孩子的遗骨，已经到了与邻居家相隔的厚沙壁底下了吧。

en.t: Perhaps the livestock shed, and the remains of your husband and child, had already ended up under the thick wall of sand separating this house from the neighbor's.

units.source_text: 说是看情况，有可能全都进了邻居家院子的底下。

en.t: Depending on the situation, you said, it was possible that everything had gone under the neighbor's yard.

units.source_text: 确实，从道理来说，还算说得过去。

en.t: To be sure, as an explanation, it more or less made sense.

units.source_text: 但是，与其说你是在撒谎，倒不如说你那貌似不幸难过得要命的表情明显表示了，你从一开始压根儿就没打算告诉我。

en.t: But rather than saying you were lying, it was more that the terribly unhappy, grief-stricken look on your face made it perfectly clear that you had never intended to tell me from the beginning.

units.source_text: 遗骨嘛，也不过是个借口。

en.t: The remains, after all, were nothing more than an excuse.

units.source_text: 我再也没有生气的力气了。

en.t: I no longer had the strength to be angry.

units.source_text: 而且，我不再执着于我俩间的恩怨了。

en.t: Besides, I was no longer clinging to the grudges between the two of us.

units.source_text: 我想，这事就是你，也不会想不通吧……

en.t: I think even you must be able to understand that much...
